messages.text: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in AI?

### Short answer
The passages do not provide an AI-specific ranking of the “most important” signal generation capabilities; the AI server ecosystem material is only a sales/test-solution mapping and not a formal product configuration, while the signal-generator passages list product capabilities without ranking them for AI applications [62][64][13][17][20][23][54].
| Capability area | Supported capabilities from the passages | Evidence gap for AI-specific importance |
|---|---|---|
| Wideband vector RF generation | R&S SMM100A supports 100 kHz to 44 GHz, up to 2 GHz internal RF modulation bandwidth, 5G NR FR1/FR2, ARB, real-time signal generation, and custom digital modulation [13][65]. R&S SMW200A RF path A covers 100 kHz to up to 67 GHz, supports internal baseband I/Q modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz, and supports many internal digital standards [20]. | The AI ecosystem passages do not directly tie these signal generator capabilities to AI workloads or rank them [62][64]. |
| Arbitrary waveform generation and replay | R&S SMCV100B includes a baseband generator with ARB, 64 Msample and 60 MHz RF bandwidth in the base instrument, with ARB memory extensions up to 1 Gsample and RF bandwidth extensions up to 240 MHz [23][47]. R&S SMW200A wideband ARB supports waveform length up to 256 Msample, or 2 Gsample with K515, sample rate up to 2400 MHz with K527, and RF bandwidth up to 2000 MHz with K527 [71]. R&S CMX500 GPRF Generator can generate ARB, CW, dual tone, and replay `.wv` waveforms, including waveforms from IQ capture, MATLAB, or other sources [7][8][9]. | The passages support ARB/replay as product capability, but do not state it is “most important” for AI [7][8][9][23][47][71]. |
| Multi-channel, MIMO, and fading/channel emulation | R&S SMW200A can scale from a single-path vector signal generator to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester, supporting up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 8 RF paths via SGT100A modules, and MIMO scenarios such as 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 8x4, 4x8, and 2x4x4 [17][20]. R&S CMX500 can use internal baseband fading emulation for 5G NR receiver tests under 3GPP fading propagation conditions [25]. | The passages support MIMO/fading capability, but do not directly connect it to AI applications [17][20][25]. |
| High-speed digital I/Q connectivity | R&S SMCV100B with SMCVB-K19 provides Dig. I/Q HS according to R&S Digital I/Q interface 40G, with QSFP+/QSFP 28 connector, digital baseband output sample rate up to 300 MHz with bandwidth options, and digital baseband input sample rate 400 Hz to 300 MHz [50]. R&S SMW200A supports HS DIG I/Q according to R&S Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R with QSFP+/QSFP 28, including wideband HS DIG I/Q modes up to 1.05 GHz or 1.25 GHz depending on configuration [73]. R&S CMX-B200A provides two high-speed digital I/Q interfaces at 40 Gbps [52]. | The AI server ecosystem mapping mentions high-speed channel/interconnect and jitter/phase-noise test contexts, but does not identify signal generators as the mapped solution for those AI-server topics [11][61][62]. |
| Standards-based signal generation | R&S SMW200A supports internal digital standards including 5G New Radio, LTE up to Release 15, NB-IoT, eMTC, 3GPP FDD/HSPA/HSPA+, GSM/EDGE/EDGE Evolution, and WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay [20]. R&S SMM100A supports 5G NR signal generation for FR1 and FR2 [13]. R&S CMX500 supports 5G NR, LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD device testing, and also provides WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements [55]. | The passages support communications-standard signal generation, but do not say these standards are AI-specific requirements [13][20][55]. |
| RF quality, impairments, and enhancement functions | R&S SMM100A is described as having excellent SSB phase noise, EVM, and ACPR/ACLR performance, plus envelope tracking and frequency response correction [13]. R&S SMW200A specifications include RF/baseband data for AWGN, enhanced noise, envelope tracking, predistortion, digital Doherty, bandwidth extension, and other enhancements [19][79]. R&S SMBV100B includes AWGN, BER/BLER measurement, envelope tracking, predistortion, frequency response correction, crest factor reduction, and notched signals options [28][29]. | The passages support these as signal generation and enhancement capabilities, but do not rank them for AI applications [13][19][28][29][79]. |

R&S CMX500 GPRF Generator can generate ARB, CW, dual tone, and replay `.wv` waveforms, including waveforms from IQ capture, MATLAB, or other sources [7][8][9]. | The passages support ARB/replay as product capability, but do not state it is “most important” for AI [7][8][9][23][47][71]. |
| Multi-channel, MIMO, and fading/channel emulation | R&S SMW200A can scale from a single-path vector signal generator to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester, supporting up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 8 RF paths via SGT100A modules, and MIMO scenarios such as 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 8x4, 4x8, and 2x4x4 [17][20]. R&S CMX500 can use internal baseband fading emulation for 5G NR receiver tests under 3GPP fading propagation conditions [25]. | The passages support MIMO/fading capability, but do not directly connect it to AI applications [17][20][25]. |
| High-speed digital I/Q connectivity | R&S SMCV100B with SMCVB-K19 provides Dig. I/Q HS according to R&S Digital I/Q interface 40G, with QSFP+/QSFP 28 connector, digital baseband output sample rate up to 300 MHz with bandwidth options, and digital baseband input sample rate 400 Hz to 300 MHz [50]. R&S SMW200A supports HS DIG I/Q according to R&S Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R with QSFP+/QSFP 28, including wideband HS DIG I/Q modes up to 1.05 GHz or 1.25 GHz depending on configuration [73]. R&S CMX-B200A provides two high-speed digital I/Q interfaces at 40 Gbps [52]. | The AI server ecosystem mapping mentions high-speed channel/interconnect and jitter/phase-noise test contexts, but does not identify signal generators as the mapped solution for those AI-server topics [11][61][62]. |
| Standards-based signal generation | R&S SMW200A supports internal digital standards including 5G New Radio, LTE up to Release 15, NB-IoT, eMTC, 3GPP FDD/HSPA/HSPA+, GSM/EDGE/EDGE Evolution, and WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay [20]. R&S SMM100A supports 5G NR signal generation for FR1 and FR2 [13]. R&S CMX500 supports 5G NR, LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD device testing, and also provides WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements [55]. | The passages support communications-standard signal generation, but do not say these standards are AI-specific requirements [13][20][55]. |
| RF quality, impairments, and enhancement functions | R&S SMM100A is described as having excellent SSB phase noise, EVM, and ACPR/ACLR performance, plus envelope tracking and frequency response correction [13]. R&S SMW200A specifications include RF/baseband data for AWGN, enhanced noise, envelope tracking, predistortion, digital Doherty, bandwidth extension, and other enhancements [19][79]. R&S SMBV100B includes AWGN, BER/BLER measurement, envelope tracking, predistortion, frequency response correction, crest factor reduction, and notched signals options [28][29]. | The passages support these as signal generation and enhancement capabilities, but do not rank them for AI applications [13][19][28][29][79]. |

passages.text:
R&S SMCV100B › 適用條件與規格定義
依 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]，產品資料適用條件：

- 在 ambient temperature 儲存 `3 小時` 後，warm-up operation `30 分鐘`。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義：

- Specifications with limits：以範圍或限制值表示 warranted product performance，使用 `<, ≤, >, ≥, ±, maximum, minimum` 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits (`n. trc.`)：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：代表 warranted product performance，通常為尺寸或設定解析度等無或可忽略偏差的值。
- Typical data (`typ.`)：代表約 `80%` 量產儀器可達到的性能，或代表平均值。
- Nominal values (`nom.`)：代表性數值，不做 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試。
- Measured values (`meas.`)：來自個別樣品的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor = `2`，依 GUM 規則計算，考慮 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

R&S SMCV100B › 文件依據
- 來源：[[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMCV100B Vector Signal Generator Specifications`
- 文件識別：`PD 3608.0627.22`
- 文件版本：`Version 17.00`
- 文件日期：來源開頭標示 `September 2025`；文件資訊頁標示 `August 2025`，見 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]] 的未解問題。
- 產品名稱：`R&S®SMCV100B Vector Signal Generator`
- Base instrument order no.：`1432.7000.02`

R&S SMCV100B › Connectors
Front panel：`RF 50 Ω` RF output，`N female`；`USB` 為 `USB 2.0 high speed`、`USB type A`，可接 external USB devices、mouse/keyboard、`R&S®NRPx` power sensors（with `R&S®NRP-Z4` or `R&S®NRP-ZKU` adapter cable）、memory stick。

Rear panel：`Ref. In` / `Ref. Out` 為 `BNC female`；`User 1`, `User 2` 為 user-configurable inputs or outputs，`BNC female`；`Dig. IQ HS 1`, `Dig. IQ HS 2` 為 high speed digital input or output，`QSFP+/QSFP 28`；`IP Data` 為 `SFP+`；rear USB 為 2 connectors，`USB 3.0 high speed`，`USB type A`；`LAN` 為 `RJ-45`；`DisplayPort` 可接 external monitor。

R&S CMX500 › RF generator
Output level uncertainties 適用於 continuous wave，不適用於 overrange；wideband applications 可能產生 additional uncertainties。

R&S CMX500 › Base unit 與主要訂購資訊
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]：

| 項目 | Type / code | Order No. | 原文說明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| CMX500 Radio communication tester | CMX500 | 1201.0002K70 | accessories 包含 power cords、operating manual (getting started)、R&S CMX-B300C cables and adapters、R&S CMX-PB70H cables and adapters |
| CMX500 basic assembly | R&S CMX-PB70H | 1222.0676.09 | basic assembly |
| R&S CMX accelerator unit | R&S CMX-B200A | 1222.0747.02 | accelerated digital signal processing capabilities |
| R&S CMX processing unit | R&S CMX-B300C | 1222.0801.04 | generic high-performance computing platform for advanced data processing |
| R&S CMX IF unit | R&S CMX-B500A | 1222.0924.02 | IF frequency range vector signal analysis and ARB based generator |
| R&S CMX RF unit | R&S CMX-B600B | 1222.0953.03 | FR1 frequency range vector signal analysis and ARB based generator |

[[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 使用 generic code [[R&S CMX-B500x]] 與 [[R&S CMX-B600x]]；[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 在 ordering information 中列出具體 orderable unit 為 [[R&S CMX-B500A]] 與 [[R&S CMX-B600B]]。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › Signal types
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，GPRF Generator signal types 包含：

- ARB。
- CW。
- Dual Tone。
- Replay `.wv` files。
- Up to 4 GPRF Generator instances in parallel。
- ARB Sequencer。
- Upload directly in the configuration sidebar。

來源 slide 標示 **No License required**，但該說法需與 technology-specific ARB / WinIQSim2 licensing 分開理解。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › Waveform replay
來源描述可 replay any waveform from：

- IQ capture。
- MATLAB。
- Other sources。

流程線索包含：

1. Convert with R&S MATLAB tools from App Note [[1GP60]]。
2. Read in complex IQ vector。
3. Add parameters（sample rate provided in `.info` file in CMX500 captures）。
4. Run conversion script from [[1GP60]]。
5. `.wv` stored in active directory。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S PCB test solutions]] 提供 2026.3.4 R&S high-speed digital 簡報中的 PCB fabricator / system house 測試流程；本頁則來自市場 Excel，將 R&S 儀器與 AI server supply-chain 類別做銷售 mapping。
- [[高頻高速 PCB 測試解決方案]] 與 [[Dk-Df]]、[[Delta-L]]、[[TDR 阻抗測量]] 已有 Keysight / PCB test 圖像來源；本頁新增 R&S 方案對應，但未提供可替代正式規格的量測條件。
- [[AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級]] 記錄材料與板層升級；本頁只補充對應測試入口，例如 IL、TDR、high speed trace、PDN Target Z。
- [[資料中心電力電子生態系]]、[[NVIDIA 800V HVDC 架構]] 與 [[AI 資料中心高壓直流供電]] 記錄 data center power electronics；本頁補充 [[MXO]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[ZISO]] 與 BMS test 的 sales mapping 線索。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › SI / high-speed channel / interconnect
- [[R&S ZNA]] 與 [[R&S ZNB]] 在來源中被放入 [[伺服器電路板]] / [[PCB]] 的 IL、TDR，以及 [[連接器]] / 線纜的 high speed cable 測試。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 也出現在 [[伺服器主機板]] / PCBA 的 high speed trace test、[[GPU]] 的 TDR、[[CPU]]、[[智原]]、[[譜瑞-KY]]等 IC / high-speed transmission context。
- [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 出現在 [[智原]] 與 [[旺矽]] 的 solution 欄，但來源未提供實際 frequency range 或 fixture。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › 來源中的 mapping
| 分類 | 對象 / 企業欄 | 來源中的 R&S Solution | 來源日期 / 期間 | 限制 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [[IC]] / 矽智財 / 製程 | [[智原]] | [[R&S ZNA]] + [[R&S ZNA67EXT]]、[[R&S FSWP]] | 來源未標示正式日期；raw converted 2026-09-17 | 未說明量測對象是 SerDes、jitter、phase noise、probe station 或 wafer / package |
| [[測試介面]] | [[旺矽]] | [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] | 來源未標示正式日期；raw converted 2026-09-17 | 未說明 probe card / socket / fixture / frequency range |
| 高速傳輸 IC | [[譜瑞-KY]] | [[R&S ZNA]] + [[R&S FSWP]] | 來源未標示正式日期；raw converted 2026-09-17 | 未說明高速傳輸 IC 類型、SerDes 速率或測試項目 |

R&S SMM100A › 定位與用途
依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]，[[R&S SMM100A]] 的主要能力包含：

- Frequency range：`100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- High output power：up to `+18 dBm`。
- Internal RF modulation bandwidth：up to `2 GHz`。
- 支援 5G NR signal generation for FR1 and FR2。
- RF frequency 與 modulation bandwidth 用於 future WLAN requirements。
- Excellent SSB phase noise、EVM、ACPR/ACLR performance。
- Internal real-time signal generation。
- Arbitrary waveform generator。
- Custom digital modulation。
- Keycode extendable bandwidth and ARB memory。
- Timed licenses、waveform packs、floating licenses。
- Structured GUI、touchscreen、block diagram operation、graphical signal monitoring in real time。
- Context-sensitive help system 與 SCPI recording。
- `R&S®SMM-K544` frequency response correction。
- Envelope tracking。
- High rate pulse（HRP）ultrawideband（UWB）。

依 [[R&S for JIO Project]]，[[R&S SMM100A]] 在 [[R&S WoMT 測試方案]] 中被簡報列為 RX sensitivity and blocking tests 的 signal source；但該簡報的 67 GHz frequency range 主張不得覆蓋正式 specifications。

R&S SMM100A › 適用條件與規格定義
依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]，產品資料適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 `3 hours` 後，warm-up operation `30 minutes`；符合 specified environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義：Specifications with limits 表示 warranted product performance；Non-traceable specifications with limits (`n. trc.`)、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。Uncertainties 的 coverage factor = `2`，依 GUM 規則計算。

R&S SMM100A › Jio WoMT use-case
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]]：

- [[R&S SMM100A]] 被列為 [[R&S WoMT 測試方案]] 的 vector signal generator。
- Source slide 說 application 為 ultra-clean reference signals for RX sensitivity and blocking tests。
- 此 use-case 可追溯到 Market / project deck，不是 SMM100A 官方 application note 或 datasheet。
- 因該 slide 的 frequency range 與正式 specs 矛盾，引用 WoMT use-case 時不可引用 `up to 67 GHz` 作為 SMM100A 規格。

R&S SMW200A › Remote control、connectors 與一般資料
- Remote control interfaces：IEC 60625 GPIB IEEE-488.2、Ethernet/LAN 10/100/1000BASE-T、USB 3.0 super speed、serial RS-232 via `R&S®TS-USB1`。
- Remote command set：`SCPI 1999.5 or compatible command sets`。
- Ethernet/LAN protocols and services：VISA VXI-11、Telnet/RawEthernet、VNC、FTP、SMB。
- Front panel RF 50 Ω path A connector：3/6/7.5 GHz options 為 N female；12.75/20/31.8/40 GHz options 為 test port adapter PC 2.92 mm female；44 GHz options 為 PC 1.85 mm male with adapter；56/67 GHz options 為 1.85 mm female with wear and tear adapter。
- Front panel RF 50 Ω path B connector：3/6/7.5 GHz options 為 N female；12.75/20/31.8 GHz options 為 test port adapter PC 2.92 mm female；44 GHz options 為 PC 1.85 mm male with adapter。
- Rear panel 包含 REF IN/OUT、INST TRG A/B、USER 4/5/6、EFC、LO IN/OUT、IEEE 488、LAN、USB DEVICE、EXT 1/2、DIG I/Q OUT、HS DIG I/Q OUT 等。
- Rated power when fully equipped：`550 W measured`；with `R&S®SMW-B94L` fully equipped：`750 W measured`。
- Operating temperature range：`0 °C to +45 °C`；with `R&S®SMW-B1056`、`R&S®SMW-B1067`、`R&S®SMW-B1067N`、`R&S®SMW-B1067O` 為 `+5 °C to +45 °C`。
- Dimensions：standard `435 mm × 192 mm × 460 mm`；with `R&S®SMW-B94L` 為 `435 mm × 192 mm × 560 mm`。
- Weight：fully equipped `21 kg`；with `R&S®SMW-B94L` fully equipped `30 kg`。
- Non-volatile memory：SSD，`512 Gbyte`。
- Recommended calibration interval：`3 years`，條件 `40 h/week operation in the full range of the specified environmental conditions`。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › 與既有資料的矛盾與更新
⚠️ [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（May 2024）說 `R&S®SMW-B1031` Order No. 是 `1428.5307.02`，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMW200A]] 說 May 2024 configuration guide 摘錄未顯示 `.02` 後綴。判斷：本次重新匯入的來源摘錄已明列完整 order number，因此本頁以 `1428.5307.02` 記錄，並移除「未顯示 `.02`」作為未決事項。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › Signal types
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，GPRF Generator signal types 包含：

- ARB。
- CW。
- Dual Tone。
- Replay `.wv` files。
- Up to 4 GPRF Generator instances in parallel。
- ARB Sequencer。
- Upload directly in the configuration sidebar。

來源 slide 標示 **No License required**，但該說法需與 technology-specific ARB / WinIQSim2 licensing 分開理解。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › Waveform replay
來源描述可 replay any waveform from：

- IQ capture。
- MATLAB。
- Other sources。

流程線索包含：

1. Convert with R&S MATLAB tools from App Note [[1GP60]]。
2. Read in complex IQ vector。
3. Add parameters（sample rate provided in `.info` file in CMX500 captures）。
4. Run conversion script from [[1GP60]]。
5. `.wv` stored in active directory。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › SI / high-speed channel / interconnect
- [[R&S ZNA]] 與 [[R&S ZNB]] 在來源中被放入 [[伺服器電路板]] / [[PCB]] 的 IL、TDR，以及 [[連接器]] / 線纜的 high speed cable 測試。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 也出現在 [[伺服器主機板]] / PCBA 的 high speed trace test、[[GPU]] 的 TDR、[[CPU]]、[[智原]]、[[譜瑞-KY]]等 IC / high-speed transmission context。
- [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 出現在 [[智原]] 與 [[旺矽]] 的 solution 欄，但來源未提供實際 frequency range 或 fixture。

R&S SMM100A › 定位與用途
依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]，[[R&S SMM100A]] 的主要能力包含：

- Frequency range：`100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- High output power：up to `+18 dBm`。
- Internal RF modulation bandwidth：up to `2 GHz`。
- 支援 5G NR signal generation for FR1 and FR2。
- RF frequency 與 modulation bandwidth 用於 future WLAN requirements。
- Excellent SSB phase noise、EVM、ACPR/ACLR performance。
- Internal real-time signal generation。
- Arbitrary waveform generator。
- Custom digital modulation。
- Keycode extendable bandwidth and ARB memory。
- Timed licenses、waveform packs、floating licenses。
- Structured GUI、touchscreen、block diagram operation、graphical signal monitoring in real time。
- Context-sensitive help system 與 SCPI recording。
- `R&S®SMM-K544` frequency response correction。
- Envelope tracking。
- High rate pulse（HRP）ultrawideband（UWB）。

依 [[R&S for JIO Project]]，[[R&S SMM100A]] 在 [[R&S WoMT 測試方案]] 中被簡報列為 RX sensitivity and blocking tests 的 signal source；但該簡報的 67 GHz frequency range 主張不得覆蓋正式 specifications。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100 › 重點摘要
- 代表性 RF performance：frequency setting resolution `0.001 Hz`；standard performance SSB phase noise 在 `1 GHz`、`20 kHz offset`、`1 Hz measurement bandwidth`、`level = 10 dBm` 條件下為 `< –134 dBc`，typ. `–140 dBc`；`R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` ultra low phase noise 在 `1 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–144 dBc`，typ. `–150 dBc`。
- Pulse modulation 需 `R&S®SMW-K22`；一般 on/off ratio `> 80 dB`，部分高頻條件例外為 `> 65 dB`；rise/fall time 依 frequency option 為 `< 10 ns` 或 `< 15 ns`（fast transition）。
- Wideband baseband `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode 支援 `400 Hz to 600 MHz` sample rate；搭配 `R&S®SMW-K525` 為 `400 Hz to 1200 MHz`，搭配 `R&S®SMW-K527` 為 `400 Hz to 2400 MHz`；對應 RF bandwidth 可到 `500 MHz`、`1000 MHz`、`2000 MHz`。
- 本文件列出 RF、baseband、digital I/Q、AWGN、enhanced noise、envelope tracking、predistortion、digital Doherty、slow I/Q、bandwidth extension、HUMS、remote control、connectors、environmental、ordering information 等資料；option code、licence code 與 order number 只照錄來源列出的內容，不推導缺欄。

SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100 › 重點摘要
- 來源是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications`，文件資訊 `PD 3606.8037.22`，`Version 31.00`，日期 `May 2026`，頁尾另標 `May 2026 (ch)`。
- 本文件補齊 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 performance specifications；既有 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]] 是 `Version 06.00`（`May 2024`）configuration guide，偏向配置規則、retrofitting 與 ordering information。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 RF path A frequency options 覆蓋 `100 kHz to 3/6/7.5/12.75/20/31.8/40/44/56/67 GHz`；RF path B 可選 `100 kHz to 3/6/7.5/12.75/20/31.8/44 GHz`。
- 架構可從 single-path [[Vector signal generator]] 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester；來源說明支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources、最多 `64` 個 fading channels，以及最多 `8` 條 RF paths（透過連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules）。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB；可對 baseband signals 做 internal digital adding，包含 frequency offset 與 level offset。

- Internal baseband I/Q modulation bandwidth in RF 最高 `2 GHz`；2 GHz bandwidth 內 modulation frequency response 為 `< 0.4 dB measured`。
- 支援 internal digital standards，例如 `5G New Radio`、`LTE up to Release 15`、`NB-IoT`、`eMTC`、`3GPP FDD/HSPA/HSPA+`、`GSM/EDGE/EDGE Evolution`、`WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay`、`DVB-S2/DVB-S2X`；來源同時另列 waveform packages for signals from [[R&S WinIQSIM2]]，其中 [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC。

SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700 › 重點摘要
- [[R&S SMCV100B]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Signal Generator；base instrument 為 `R&S®SMCV100B`，Order No. `1432.7000.02`，包含 baseband generator with ARB（`64 Msample`, `60 MHz RF bandwidth`）、power cable、quick start guide。

  - `R&S®SMCVB-B103` + `R&S®SMCVB-KB106` + `R&S®SMCVB-KB107`：`4 kHz to 7.125 GHz`。

CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100 › 重點摘要
- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD 與 TDD device testing。

- 版權：© 2019–2025 [[Rohde & Schwarz]]。

- [[R&S FSWP]] 在 [[網通交換機]]分類中被列為 jitter / phase noise test。
- [[R&S FSWP]] 也出現在 [[電源供應器]]的 LDO NSD test、[[智原]]與[[譜瑞-KY]]的 IC / high-speed transmission solution 欄，但未提供測試條件。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping
[[AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping]] 是用來保存 [[AISeverEcosystem]] 中 AI server ecosystem 分類與 [[R&S Solution]] 欄位對應關係的概念頁；它只表示該 Excel 表中的銷售 / 測試方案線索，不代表正式產品配置、客戶關係或已驗證商機。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › 可追溯限制
- 本頁只追溯到 [[AISeverEcosystem]] 的 Excel 轉檔內容。
- 來源未標示正式日期，因此本頁不可用來判斷 2026-09-18 當下市場狀態或客戶優先順序。

- 表內 `NaN` 不代表無 solution 或無商機，只代表轉檔來源該欄未提供可讀文字。

R&S SMM100A
[[R&S SMM100A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Signal Generator；依 `R&S®SMM100A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`，透過 `R&S®SMM-B10xx` frequency options 覆蓋 `100 kHz to 6 GHz` 到 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`，並支援最高 `2 GHz` internal RF modulation bandwidth、5G NR FR1/FR2、ARB、real-time baseband、custom digital modulation、envelope tracking 與 HUMS（來源：[[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]）。

⚠️ [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]（June 2026）讀圖補充 p049 與 p051 頁尾說 `R&S®SMW100A Vector Signal Generator`，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說本文件產品為 `R&S®SMM100A Vector Signal Generator`。判斷為來源頁尾疑似誤植；本頁仍以封面、p050、文件名稱、ordering information 與 source_path 的 `SMM100A` 為主，並在 Unresolved 保留此不一致。

⚠️ [[R&S for JIO Project]]（2026-09-17 converted；來源未標示正式日期）說 [[R&S SMM100A]] Frequency Range: Up to 67 GHz，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]（June 2026 / May 2026 未決）SMM100A 最高 frequency option 為 100 kHz to 44 GHz。判斷：[[R&S for JIO Project]] 是 Market / project deck，且同一簡報 slide 24 另列 [[R&S SMA100B]] 8 kHz to 67 GHz；因此 67 GHz 很可能是簡報混淆或 sales-slide 錯植。正式規格以 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]] 為準，Jio WoMT use-case 中引用此簡報時需保留矛盾。

R&S SMW200A › Wideband baseband
- `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode：waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`；with `K515` 到 `2 Gsample`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` sample rate：`400 Hz to 600 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `400 Hz to 1200 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `400 Hz to 2400 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` RF bandwidth：`500 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `1000 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `2000 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9F` 詳細 GNSS 規格見 `GNSS simulation for Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generators specifications`，文件 `PD 3607.6896.22`。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。
